description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for an OCDM (Open Content Decrypt Module) plugin in a C++ project. It includes class definitions, interface implementations, nested JSON data structures, and references to external interfaces, primarily for handling content decryption functionalities within a plugin architecture.

classes.name: OCDM
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing content decryption, web, and JSON RPC interfaces with lifecycle management and nested data structures.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class for handling remote connection notifications, notifying parent OCDM instance of connection activation or deactivation.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: Nested data container class for serializing/deserializing OCDM system data, including nested System class.

classes.name: Data::System
classes.description: Represents individual system entries with name and designators, used within the main Data container.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the service object; sets up resources.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when plugin is unloaded.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
